title: Volvo Seies 5 FH16 Low Profile Hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Roadtrain Bullbar #49
description: Volvo FH16 Series 5 Hi-tensile 6 Post Heavy Duty Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Custom built with low uprights allowing for cabin front panel to be raised to facilitate daily checks. Radar compatible. Custom driving light mounts and LED indicator repeater/daylight running lights mounted in the external box uprights. Flip over Road Train & Long Vehicle signs on aluminium plate. Lower pipe extensions for maximum headlight protection. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate (save 90kgs compared to steel backing plate) with dual tow pins.
